models_evaluated: ML-based precision-targeting model for MTM assignment

links.outcome: MTM call favorability (acceptance of pharmacist consultation), ML-targeted vs traditional eligibility-based assignment
links.effect: 21.2% vs 12.6% call favorability; 8.6% absolute increase, 68% relative improvement (RR 1.68), P<0.001; E value 2.75.
links.quote: The ML cohort showed a 21.2% call favorability rate vs 12.6% in the historical cohort, an 8.6% absolute increase and 68% relative improvement (risk ratio = 1.68).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world operational implementation of an ML precision-targeting model to prioritize patients for medication therapy management compared to standard eligibility rules, but it evaluates the model's implementation impact itself rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
